title: UI pass renders: changed views at 80x24, 120x40 and ASCII on the approval card

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Retrospective R4 (docs/review-2026-10-25-relay-retrospective.md). The UI pass read goldens and text only; the owner's human check then lagged as adj records. adj 165 recommends renders shown on the approval card.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/runrec/record.go`: the card lists renders by name and size (`ui_round`, `renders`, `renders_dropped`).
- `internal/runrec/plain.go`: plain text of a render (escape sequences and control characters dropped).
- `internal/engine/approval.go`: list the UI pass renders on the card (order, limits, no links) and `ReadRender`, which reads one on demand.
- `internal/engine/round.go`: clear the UI pass renders directory when its round starts.
- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: the `run.render` call (`runRender`, `RenderReply`).
- `internal/daemon/handlers.go`: route `run.render`.
- `internal/daemon/client.go`: `Client.Render`.
- `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md`: the UI pass writes the renders to its temp directory.
- `internal/tui/card.go`: the renders line, the render viewer, its fetch through `run.render`, and the key line.
- `internal/tui/pane.go`: show a render in place of the run tree and the card footer.
- `internal/tui/model.go`: keep the answer of a render call.
- `internal/tui/view.go`: collapse the Overview rows while a render shows; `v view renders` in the help line.
- `internal/tui/keys.go`: the `v` key.
- `internal/engine/renders_test.go`, `internal/daemon/render_test.go`, `internal/tui/renders_test.go`, `internal/tui/card_test.go`: tests.
- `testdata/golden/approval-render-80x24-mono-false.txt`, `testdata/golden/approval-render-80x24-mono-true.txt`: the viewer at 80x24.
- `testdata/golden/action-help-mono-false.txt`, `testdata/golden/action-help-mono-true.txt`, `testdata/golden/version-help-100x30-mono-false.txt`, `testdata/golden/version-help-100x30-mono-true.txt`, `testdata/golden/version-help-tall-mono-false.txt`, `testdata/golden/version-help-tall-mono-true.txt`: help goldens.
- `docs/state.md`, `docs/dashboard.md`, `docs/design.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: the behaviour (storage path and card fields marked proposed).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Depends on the UI pass role and the approval card slices. Mark the storage path proposed.

Owner decision (2026-10-26 session, AskUserQuestion): the UI pass role writes the changed views at 80x24, 120x40 and ASCII as text files in its report directory, using the project's own tooling; ork stores them with the run and the approval card shows them. No project-specific render code in ork; golden_test.go is not a Files entry for ork's engine (it stays ork's own test). Re-anchor Files after S117 and S118 land.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./...; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint. UI slice: UI pass (r14).
